newsitem.title: USA: VIMRx to buy stake in Innovir.
newsitem.headline: VIMRx to buy stake in Innovir.

text.p: VIMRx Pharmaceuticals Inc said it agreed to acquire a 66 percent controlling interest in Innovir Laboratories Inc and provide Innovir with $7 million of operating capital.
VIMRx also said it committed to provide an additional $2 million capital infusion.
VIMRx and Innovir develop complementary therapeutic technologies that seek to control disease-triggering flaws in genetic chemistry.

Under terms of the deal, the Aries Funds, which already owns four million shares of Innovir stock, will exercise warrants to purchase an additional six million shares. VIMRx said it will then purchase 9.5 million Innovir shares from the Aries Funds for $12.35 million in VIMRx stock.
VIMRx said it will also exchange its 100 percent stake in its VIMRx Holdings Ltd unit with Innovir for 8.7 million shares of Innovir stock.
As part of the deal, VIMRx also has the right to nominate a majority of Innovir's board.
